name: Net Proceeds
definition: Offer price less discount and all seller-borne contributions (buyer agent commission, buyer closing cost, down payment assistance)

name: Certainty of Close
definition: Likelihood the transaction completes, mapped from the financing arrangement
normalisation: rule map: all cash 1.0, conventional loan 0.8, contract for deed 0.6, other 0.5

name: Timeline Fit
definition: Proximity of the proposed closing date to the seller's preferred closing date

name: Contingency Risk
definition: Exposure to delay and renegotiation: seller-paid repairs, replacements, other requests, plus inspection period priced at 1000 USD per day

name: Seller Expense Impact
definition: Direct financial obligations the buyer asks the seller to carry
normalisation: min(x) / x, with zero expense mapped to 1.0

name: Immediate Possession Fit
definition: Whether the offer accommodates the seller's immediate possession requirement
